meta.purpose: Conservative decision support; not an automated order system.

portfolio.note: Only explicitly executed holdings are included; recommendations are separate.

limitations: Returns use stated entry and exit prices, not necessarily executable prices.
Fixed-stake results exclude spread, fees, slippage and overlapping capital usage.

guardrails: Never enter from a stale quote.
Never enter without a current bid/ask spread.
Reject a signal when the executable price has drifted too far from publication.
Treat the full premium as at risk for leveraged products unless proven otherwise.
